t: You're looking at Jacob, the circle dray horse, a sculpture by Shirley Pace. Pace was a British artist who lived from 1933 to 2023, and she made this piece. The title points to a dray horse, the kind of heavy working horse that once pulled brewers' carts, and the word circle hints at the shape of the design. Take a moment to look at the horse's build and the way the curve of the sculpture carries your eye around it.
